Latin word

abeō

abeō, abīre, abiī, abitum

verb, irregular (like eō), conjugation

go away, go off; go away, leave

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Cas. 148: St! tacē atque abī.; Cic. Cat. 1.20: abīre in aliquās terrās (Lewis & Short)

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. Ep. 2.2.215: tempus abīre tibi est; Plaut. Aul. 89: abī intrō; Traupman 275; Traupman 389; Traupman 338
